title: GemForgedChronicles - WIP - test if you like
author: Shnatrix
selftext:
Hi community 👋 

I've been working on a pixel art game for awhile, my key problems lie in animation but I have a gameplay loop, go out fight the bads, come back upgrade your weapons and armour and go fight the bads some more.

Ultimately I want this to be a web2 to web3 integration game.

With the focus being around play to win / earn.

The currencies in game can become crypto currency to sell if you wish to others who wish to use it for upgrades.

While in testing the currency limits are generous and cost mechanics are light.

When I do launch it properly there will be low drop chance items that you can exchange for real items

Pokemon card packs
Keycaps for your keyboard
Other items or collabs and collectables

So it becomes a hunt for these items and I have additional game play loops to add in later.

It's a browser based game and built on replit 
https://gemforgedchronicles.com/

Please feel free to test and provide feedback if you would like to.

It's not letting me post if it's not a promotion - so I guess it's that, but really just showing what's being built.

comments.author: Downtown_Lettuce9911
comments.body:
It’s good that you added the “Continue with Google” option for sign up. Maybe you could also add “Continue with Apple” in a future update for more convenience.   
At the start of the game, I couldn’t see my character clearly. When I moved, my character was behind the front road, the gate, and even the gate itself at times. I also noticed that my character kept getting blocked by many trees, making it hard to see where to go.   
You might want to fix these issues and add a “How to Play” section or explain the game mechanics. After that, you could try sharing the game on vibecodinglist website to get additional feedback from other users.

replies.author: Shnatrix
replies.body:
I have implemented the fade function to the trees.

I will add a function for entry nodes to make it easier to find.

I will work on a how to play section also shortly

comments.author: Shnatrix
comments.body:
Just a small note on this for those tracking it's progress.

I'm going through a significant UI edit, so the game will for the moment not be playable (easily).

After consulting a few people these are a few alterations I'll be making.

Animation - (Q4 25 - Q1 26)
I'll likely pay an animator to make some basic sprites. As AI Animation isn't up to scratch

Real world value in game (Q1 26)
- a long with web3 NFTs, there will be drops to find like pokemon cards, keyboard keycaps, gaming equipment etc within the game. Random mobs can drop them and once found it you have to return it in town, it'll be validated and then we can send the goods to you.

These will start small as it's a small project but grow to bigger give aways in time.
